verdict.rationale: Morph's own docs claim high-throughput generation for its specialized models: Fast Apply via morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and Reflex classifiers labeling a turn in ~90ms. Default prefix caching and dedicated reserved-capacity endpoints further support latency-sensitive serving, and the GitHub demos corroborate the speed positioning at 4,500+ tok/s. missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token figures, throughput/latency numbers for the general open-weight chat models (e.g. Kimi K3), independent or hands-on benchmark corroboration of the speed claims.
